description: Feux de Signalisation GPS is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by OpenStreetMap. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. The portal shows 363 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-10-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
